cases.title: Scenario 1: Batasan Hills outage, cause and restoration time

grade.notes: Tala stayed English-led with natural 'po', 'Naku' and 'Verified na po kayo', and was empathetic about the work-from-home problem. The replies were a bit long and blunt at the end ('I can't open a separate report... I don't have other contact channels') with no apology or warm closing, and the 'Gusto n'yo po ba' line leaned more Tagalog than the style asks.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Hello po, thank you for calling Kidlat Fiber! I'm Tala, an AI assistant, and this call is recorded for quality. How can I help you po?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Hello po, Tala. Si Maria Santos po ito, taga-Batasan Hills, Quezon City. Wala po kasing internet namin simula kaninang umaga, gusto ko lang pong malaman kung ano po ang nangyari at kailan babalik.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Sorry to hear that po, Ma'am. Let me help you check, but first I need to verify your account. May I have your Kidlat Fiber account number and the last four digits of your registered mobile number?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Opo, ang account number ko po ay 8012345601. Tapos yung last four digits ng mobile number ko po ay 0101.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Thank you po. Let me verify your account first.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Verified na po kayo, Ma'am Maria. Let me check your area for outages now.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Naku, there's a fiber cable cut along Batasan Road because of road works, po. It started at around 3:42 PM today, and service is expected back by around 10:12 PM tonight.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Ah, ganoon po ba. Pero po, kaninang umaga pa po wala ang internet namin, hindi po 3:42 PM. Pareho po ba talaga ito ng problema sa lugar namin? Kasi po nagwo-work from home ako.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: I understand po, nakakaabala talaga lalo na kung nagwo-work from home kayo. The only outage I see in your area started at 3:42 PM, so I can't confirm if your problem this morning is related. I also can't open a separate report on this call. Gusto n'yo po ba ang outage reference number?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Opo, sige po, pakibigay na lang po yung reference number. Tapos kung hindi po related yung nangyari kaninang umaga, paano ko po ba ma-report yun? Kung babalik po talaga ng 10:12 PM, okay na po sana.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: The reference is O, U, T, then 2026, then 0412. I can't open a separate report on this call, and I don't have other contact channels to give you. If your internet isn't back after 10:12 PM, please call us again po so it can be checked further.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Sige po, naintindihan ko. Tatawag na lang po ulit ako kung wala pa rin pagdating ng 10:12 PM. Maraming salamat po sa tulong, Tala. Paalam na po!

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Kidlat Fiber po. Ingat po!
